item.title: Implement safe_extract.py from SPEC with focused boundary tests
item.brief:
Implement safe_extract.py according to SPEC.md. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests beyond the existing basic coverage. Use only the Python standard library. Run the relevant tests and commit the work locally. pr.body: Implemented complete batch validation, POSIX path checks, duplicate and file/directory collision detection, and lstat-based root and destination checks that reject symlinks and existing targets. Files are created exclusively and written as exact bytes; filesystem I/O failures remain visible. Added focused coverage for malformed inputs, invalid roots and paths, collisions, preexisting targets, symlinks, no-write-on-validation-failure, literal percent signs, and exact bytes. Verification: `python -m unittest -v` (10 passed) and `git diff --check` (passed), on commit db6b612071144f8425b061cccc22933d5bfaf119. A read-only reviewer passed the complete base-to-head diff with no findings. Assumption: filesystem state is stable during validation and writes, as specified. No outstanding findings.
pr.summary: Implemented safe regular file extraction with full-batch and path validation. Before: extraction raised NotImplementedError; now: safe nested writes work and invalid batches, paths, conflicts, and symlinks are rejected before mutation.
